exam_format: Linear (online proctored or in-person Pearson VUE)

testing_centers.notes: In-person and online proctored via Pearson VUE

id_requirements: Government-issued photo ID. Name must match registration exactly.
exam_rules: Closed-book. No notes or reference materials. Online proctored or in-person at Pearson VUE. SAP certifications do not expire once passed (except SuccessFactors and cloud certs which require annual validation).
renewal_options: Most SAP certifications do not expire. SAP SuccessFactors and cloud solution certifications require annual validation via a delta exam or stay current exam.

retake_policy.notes: No official waiting period. Full exam fee ($562) required for retake. Unlimited attempts.

editorial.meta_description: Prepare for the C_BW4HANA_27 certification exam. Review domains for reporting, data modeling, data acquisition, planning, and SAP HANA integration.
editorial.overview: The SAP Certified Application Associate — Reporting, Modeling and Data Acquisition with SAP BW/4HANA 2.x exam, certified by SAP, covers data modeling and InfoProviders, data acquisition and transformation, reporting and analysis, planning functions, administration and monitoring, and SAP HANA integration. Candidates must master BW Modeling Tools in Eclipse, including InfoObjects, DataStore Objects, CompositeProviders, and Open ODS Views across the architecture.
editorial.who_should_take: Application associates and technical consultants working with SAP BW/4HANA modeling tools in Eclipse, data acquisition pipelines, and reporting who need to validate their knowledge of enterprise data warehousing concepts.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Review official SAP study documentation and practice modeling tasks in Eclipse. Focus heavily on configuring DataStore Objects, defining CompositeProviders, managing data flows, understanding Open ODS Views, and mastering transformation routines using ABAP or SAP HANA SQLScript. Work through practical exercises covering data tiering and query properties.

domain_guidance.summary: This specific domain covers basic core data modeling principles using InfoProviders, InfoObjects, and DataStore Objects directly within the enterprise SAP BW/4HANA environment during everyday practical implementation tasks.

This particular module focuses heavily on advanced data acquisition methods, source systems, DataSources, extensive transformations, and standard data transfer processes designed for enterprise system pipelines and data loading operations.

Candidates examine reporting structures, query design principles, variables, formulas, and complex analytical components built on top of underlying SAP BW/4HANA analytical models intended specifically for business intelligence users.

This domain deals extensively with planning functions and integrated business planning capabilities supported natively within the overall SAP BW/4HANA enterprise system architecture for financial and operational forecasting.

This section addresses primary administrative tasks, continuous monitoring of data transfer processes, system security, user authorizations, and structured transport management workflows across landscape development tiers to maintain stability.

This final domain examines deep integration features with SAP HANA, including external SQL views, high performance calculation views, and highly optimized database processing routines for enhanced system performance.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Ensure you arrive early for your scheduled Pearson VUE exam session or test your online proctored setup beforehand. Manage your 180 minutes carefully across the 80 questions to maintain adequate pacing.

faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?
faq.answer_text: The exam consists of exactly 80 questions in total, presented in various formats such as multiple choice, multiple select, drag and drop, and matching types.
To successfully pass this certification exam, candidates must achieve a minimum passing score of 66 out of the total available points provided on the test.
You are given a total duration of 180 minutes to complete all questions included on the certification exam session without any exceptions or extensions allowed.
The official exam registration fee is priced at 562.0 USD. Please check directly with SAP for any updates or regional pricing variations before booking.

methodology.summary: This thorough page was built using official SAP exam guides, detailed study documentation, and structured domain weights to provide reliable factual guidance for candidates.

lifecycle.summary: SAP retired C_BW4HANA_27. C_BW4H is the direct replacement path.
